description: Hand classification of the 24 misses of milestone part 1 (20260928T153348Z, support-2, with PACDS), made from the agent's questions, PACDS's answers and the reviewed fix before the phase 4 classifier ran. Reference for its acceptance check. pacds_wrong and pacds_wrong_evidence are not told apart here (that needs reading the code PACDS read), so compare them as one mode.

debezium-235ZsPkW7Gc.why: PACDS called the loop normal waiting (normal_wait) although database_condition was an option; the redo thread state decides

debezium-2ZsPChtI7Uw.why: asked about a regression in LSN flushing for filtered heartbeats; PACDS answered 0.04

debezium-3xTzHU1C8zE.why: PACDS pointed to the header.converter setting; the agent chose infrastructure

debezium-91wF33PoYRQ.why: PACDS said the setup is not the documented configuration (dbname must be the CDB); the agent chose DB privileges

debezium-ALIxwqtj7Pg.why: asked whether the signal collection must be published/captured; PACDS answered 0.02

debezium-CipJUldxoMw.why: no question about the offset key the tombstone was written under

debezium-Jxyh0y4i9u8.why: no question about grants or who controls table access

debezium-MYq3pBAUM0k.why: PACDS blamed MySQL metadata/binlog inconsistency over not_supported

debezium-Mw2Yfy1E0d8.why: PACDS called the NPE an application bug and field-name casing not deliberate

debezium-ReeFrKXaYoA.why: no question about Schema Registry compatibility, which decides

debezium-TjLRh4dUVgc.why: no question about who controls WAL retention (PostgreSQL)

debezium-U4v7vSxIC7Y.why: PACDS said the timestamp precision comes from Oracle; the agent chose user error

debezium-Vuns6tBtCVY.why: PACDS called the header handling a bug (0.97) rather than a required schema-enabled header converter

debezium-YRoDgcRILXg.why: questions chased snapshot_scn reuse; none asked about UNDO retention versus snapshot duration

debezium-axkE6TUDjdA.why: PACDS said deletes are routed deliberately and blamed ACLs; tombstones are not handled

debezium-bm86U7Emho0.why: questions were about snapshot.mode only, not the XStream outbound server

debezium-dnUoF1ScZyg.why: PACDS found newlines kept in table names; the agent treated it as the user's formatting

debezium-gMvgDhb6lCQ.why: PACDS put the fix in deployment/Oracle config over connector_setting

debezium-hinIKiXIF_A.why: PACDS called the offset check intentional and denied a regression (0.03)

debezium-j6wpqDQha58.why: PACDS denied a regression (0.02) and blamed the Oracle environment

debezium-rCWFGAIHrrk.why: no question about running the Cassandra connector standalone versus in Kafka Connect

debezium-sOUypJhYmKM.why: PACDS blamed runtime incompatibility and denied a defect (0.02); the fix was Debezium code

debezium-vDFALV6qCcI.why: PACDS called the numeric mismatch accidental (1.0); the payload was inconsistent
